visual.observations: Account menu, password/KDF review, Send email and file views are legible with intact group corners and accessible controls. Actual 1.5-scale deletion warning and receiver text wrap without lost controls. Two large-scale images inspected individually; six normal-scale images inspected in a contact sheet. The custom-target capture is scrolled, so only its visible controls are assessed; off-screen top content is not claimed to be captured.
visual.limits: English/light representative native views only; not every locale, theme or page. New UI screenshots use synthetic callbacks/transport. Text-layout scale also asserted by passing device methods.
